{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRkquM8AAAABZmBLTA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5zhDMjYE", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5", "number": 105, "title": "Resolve and correct preconfigured late H-only IRQ delivery across NTSC scanline boundaries", "body": "## Problem

Late horizontal IRQs still use an explicitly approximate fallback. At baseline `8b5e3a7b3d6960375250e92804924c41614ff2b8`, `SystemBus::tick` adds the established 14-master-clock delay only when assertion fits strictly inside the current scanline; otherwise it asserts at the undelayed comparison. No delayed event survives rollover. This leaves a concrete gap after #99 and #103 and is the next work identified by the supplied assessment. [Implementation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/8b5e3a7b3d6960375250e92804924c41614ff2b8/crates/snes-core/src/machine.rs#L195-L277).

The existing `horizontal_irq_zero_delay_and_approximate_late_controls` test preserves this fallback deliberately; passing it does not establish the hardware rule. Correct its H-only expectations when supported evidence replaces the approximation. [Existing controls](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/8b5e3a7b3d6960375250e92804924c41614ff2b8/crates/snes-core/src/machine/horizontal_irq_tests.rs#L160-L190).

## Expected outcome

Implement an evidence-supported correction for **preconfigured NTSC non-interlaced H-only timer IRQs near scanline rollover**, including the shortened scanline and natural field boundaries. Timer registers and H-only enable remain stable throughout each tested comparison/delivery interval. VTIME must not select or suppress H-only events.

Resolving the exact late-comparison rule is a necessary implementation prerequisite. Establish valid late HTIME values, whether delayed assertion crosses rollover or is suppressed, and the exact resulting clock/line ownership. Do not infer these rules merely by applying modulo arithmetic to the existing same-line formula.

This is an implementation Issue: documenting the uncertainty or adding tests that preserve the fallback alone does not complete it. Report an unresolved specification prerequisite honestly if a supported correction cannot be established.

## Context and reproduction

### Hardware specification basis

The repository's recorded reconciliation of **Fullsnes, SNES Timing H/V Events and SNES PPU Interrupts**, establishes H-only assertion at `4 * HTIME + 14` master clocks in the supported same-line domain. CPU timer units are four master clocks; PPU long-dot counter conversion is separate. H-only HTIME=0 asserts at master H=14 on naturally entered lines. V-only and combined HTIME=0 use H=10. [Fullsnes](https://problemkaputt.de/fullsnes.htm), [#99 reconciliation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/8b5e3a7b3d6960375250e92804924c41614ff2b8/docs/issue-99-validation.md#source-reconciliation-recorded-before-implementation), [#103 reconciliation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/8b5e3a7b3d6960375250e92804924c41614ff2b8/docs/issue-103-validation.md#source-reconciliation-2026-10-24).

NTSC non-interlaced ordinary lines contain 1364 master clocks. Field-1 V=240 contains 1360, including during forced blank; fields contain 262 lines. STAT78 field reporting changes at V=0/master H=4, separately from raster rollover. [Fullsnes](https://problemkaputt.de/fullsnes.htm), [SNESdev Timing revision 1467](https://snes.nesdev.org/w/index.php?title=Timing&oldid=1467), [recorded geometry reconciliation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/8b5e3a7b3d6960375250e92804924c41614ff2b8/docs/issue-95-validation.md#specification-reconciliation-recorded-before-implementation).

**Unresolved:** the local records explicitly do not establish a complete late-delivery rule. Fullsnes's documented endpoint distinctions must be reconciled with its detailed timing list and [Anomie's Register Doc revision 1157](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gilligan/snesdev/master/docs/snes_registers.txt), particularly NMITIMEN, HTIME/VTIME and TIMEUP. Do not assume that late H/V wording establishes H-only behavior, or that PPU H=339 determines the CPU timer endpoint. These external documents were referenced through repository records during planning, not independently retrieved.

### Current behavior

Source inspection gives the following baseline assertion offsets; these are implementation observations, not verified hardware requirements:

| HTIME | Ordinary line | Short line |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 336 | H=1358 | H=1358 |
| 337 | H=1362 | H=1348, undelayed fallback |
| 338 | H=1352, undelayed fallback | H=1352, undelayed fallback |
| 339 | H=1356, undelayed fallback | H=1356, undelayed fallback |
| 340 | H=1360, undelayed fallback | No event |
| 341 / 511 | No event | No event |

Reproduce the existing approximation controls with:

```sh
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --lib horizontal_irq_zero_delay_and_approximate_late_controls
```

Use naturally reached lines and clear earlier pending IRQs before the target comparison. Clearing only after rollover could conceal an incorrectly early event. Planning involved read-only inspection; no suites were rerun.

### Focused scope and non-goals

Cover late H-only HTIME=337–339, with adjacent 336/340/341/511 controls to establish endpoint behavior. Include ordinary lines, the odd-field V=240 short line, its following line, and V=261→0 field rollover. Implement only the reconciled H-only rule and necessary scheduler state.

Keep combined H/V late delivery and VTIME ownership separate. Preserve existing combined-mode approximation controls as explicitly unverified policies. Also exclude live timer/mode writes during comparison or delivery, TIMEUP write-clear and physical coincident-read disputes, reset alignment, NMI delays, CPU recognition phases, DMA alignment, PAL/interlace/overscan and raster rendering.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Before runtime changes, record a source-backed timing table for the scoped HTIME values on both line geometries. State comparator eligibility, exact assertion clock and resulting line/field, or suppression. Identify source statements, arithmetic deductions and unresolved behavior separately. Reconcile contradictory register summaries and detailed event descriptions; supersede unsupported earlier test contracts explicitly.
- [ ] Implement the supported late H-only correction. A comparison/delivery crossing a line or field boundary must neither disappear nor assert early or twice under the established rule. Preserve H-only independence from VTIME, including VTIME=262 and 511. Keep unrelated mode behavior unchanged.
- [ ] Add original `late_horizontal_irq` unit regressions with independent literal clock oracles: fresh observations before/at/after the established event, old fallback positions, rollover, endpoint controls, pending retention, early acknowledgement and subsequent delivery. Exercise ordinary and short lines, both natural parities, V=239/240/241 and V=261→0. Expected values must not call production scheduling or PPU conversion helpers.
- [ ] Verify one-clock, irregular and whole-interval advancement across multiple natural fields. Check IRQ timing, raster/field state, retained controller/HDMA state and independently calculated audio counts. PCM partition equality establishes determinism only.
- [ ] Exercise timed CPU TIMEUP reads and actual DMA reads across a corrected rollover event. Add a DMA-held CPU case showing device advancement, retained IRQ and deferred CPU service. Distinguish existing access-end sampling, immediate acknowledgement and DMA phases from measured hardware behavior.
- [ ] Add an original source-built MIT 65C816 guest under the `late_horizontal_irq` test target. It must preconfigure the tested H-only timer, reach both line geometries naturally, distinguish corrected behavior from the fallback in guest-executed assertions, and publish success/failure markers with bounded deadlines. Host code may load, step and observe; it must not inject timing or result state. Record authorship, construction and independent clock arithmetic in `tests/roms/PROVENANCE.md`.
- [ ] Transfer only new tests and necessary test registration to an isolated export of exact baseline `8b5e3a7b3d6960375250e92804924c41614ff2b8`. Demonstrate successful compilation followed by behavioral failures for the new focused unit regression and guest, then passes with the correction. Record actual commands and outputs.
- [ ] Run focused gates:

```sh
cargo test --locked -p snes-core late_horizontal_irq
cargo test --locked -p snes-core horizontal_irq
cargo test --locked -p snes-core horizontal_zero_irq
cargo test --locked -p snes-core combined_zero_irq
cargo test --locked -p snes-core v_only_irq
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test ntsc_timing
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --lib machine::ntsc_timing_tests
```

- [ ] Pass formatting, warning-denying Clippy and the full workspace suite. Preserve CPU/WAI, zero/nonzero IRQ, NMI, geometry, controller, DMA/HDMA, PPU-port and audio regressions:

```sh
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace --locked
```

- [ ] Execute the existing source-built hardware and browser gates from [README validation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/8b5e3a7b3d6960375250e92804924c41614ff2b8/README.md#validate): reproduce the smoke fixture; build pinned assemblers; run `hardware-tests.py` with ca65/ld65/spcasm and `ppu-test.py` with bass; build cleared games twice; run `npm --prefix web ci`, production build, Chromium installation and `npm --prefix web test -- --grep-invert '301 seconds'`. Preserve fixture/game pins, hashes, replay inputs, gameplay/progression/music assertions, deadlines and tolerances. Use original or explicitly licensed source-built tests; acquire no commercial ROM or firmware.
- [ ] Update README and a focused validation record with the corrected contract, baseline counterexamples, actual results, failures/skips and remaining uncertainty. Passing these tests must not be described as complete hardware accuracy or commercial compatibility.

All supplied inventory scopes remain intact. `cpu`, `bus`, `scheduler`, `dma`, `hdma`, `controllers`, `ppu-bg`, `ppu-offset`, `ppu-hires`, `ppu-mode7`, `ppu-objects`, `ppu-color`, `ppu-ports`, `ppu-display`, `spc`, `ipl`, `dsp-voices`, `dsp-noise`, `dsp-pitch`, `dsp-envelope`, `dsp-echo` and `dsp-timing` remain partial; `ppu-raster` and `pal` remain unimplemented. None becomes fully verified. Remaining scheduler work includes combined late IRQ ownership, live configuration, TIMEUP disputes, startup/reset alignment, NMI delays, refresh revisions, physical recognition and broader synchronization, including APU-before-raster advancement. This Issue does not complete Issue #3.

## Optional validation

Physical-device corroboration using the original diagnostic, if independently available. It is not required for merge. The existing optional 301-second wall-clock browser soak also remains optional.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
